name: Ex Wife Richer Colder Untouchable
overview: Renata Ledesma, CEO of Corporación Ledesma, has always loved her husband, Diego Hurtado, above all else. She gifts him a Porsche, a luxurious villa, and even a credit card with a hundred-million-dollar limit, in addition to covering the expenses of his parents and sister. Yet Diego, living comfortably off her fortune, does not hesitate to rekindle his relationship with his first love, Emilia Portillo...
